master.title: DAILY HEADLINES 14.02.2022 as at 06h30
master.content:
DAILY HEADLINES
Brussels, 14.02.2022 as at 06h30


TOP STORY UKRAINE-RUSSIA:

Ukraine's president has played down intensified warnings of a possible Russian invasion within days, saying he has yet to see convincing evidence. Volodymyr Zelensky's comments came even as the US warned of more Russian troops pressing closer to Ukraine's borders and some airlines cancelled or diverted flights to the country. (AP/Irish Examiner) more.

Le pr sident am ricain Joe Biden et son homologue ukrainien Volodymyr Zelensky ont convenu de poursuivre la "diplomatie" et la "dissuasion" face la Russie, lors d'une conversation t l phonique d'environ 50 minutes dimanche, a rapport la Maison Blanche. (AFP/Le Figaro) plus..

Ukraine said on Sunday it wanted talks with Russia and members of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) within 48 hours to discuss Russia's military build-up near Ukraine and inside annexed Crimea. (Reuters/National Post) more..

Ukraine's government on Sunday allocated 16.6 billion hryvnia ($592 million) to guarantee the continuation of flights through Ukrainian airspace, Prime Minister Denys Shmygal said. (Reuters/National Post) more..

More airlines are likely to avoid Ukraine's airspace amid insurance issues and a decision by leading European carriers to stop overflights after a U.S. warning that Russia could invade at any time, a flight operations advisory firm said on Monday. (Reuters/Financial Post)more..

Poland's Interior Minister Mariusz Kaminski on Sunday said his country is preparing for "various scenarios" in anticipation of a possible influx of refugees from Ukraine if Russia invades the country. (The Hill) more..

Canada has temporarily withdrawn its Ukraine-based military personnel to an undisclosed destination in Europe, the Canadian defence ministry said on Sunday. (Reuters/National Post) more..

Ukraine crisis live (The Guardian)


EUROPE AND CENTRAL ASIA


SERBIA: A protest in support of locals from endangered areas, who have been camping in front of Serbia's Presidency building for four days in the fight for the introduction of a permanent moratorium on lithium and boron research and excavation, is being held in the centre of Belgrade. (N1 News) more..

MIDDLE EAST AND NORTHERN AFRICA


The IRANIAN army has set up a missile unit, Tasnim news agency reported on Sunday, quoting a senior commander as saying. The missile unit has been established in the army' Ground Force, the force's Commander Kiomars Heidari said. The Ground Force is planning to upgrade equipment and introduce new gear suitable for rapid reaction operations and is developing automated and smart ordnance capable of hitting targets at long distances with pinpoint accuracy, he said. (Xinhua) more..

IRAN/JCPOA: A senior Iranian security official said on Monday that progress in talks to salvage Iran's 2015 nuclear deal was becoming "more difficult" as Western powers only "pretended" to come up with initiatives. [...] Mikhail Ulyanov, Russia's envoy to the talks in Vienna, said on Twitter hours earlier: "Significant progress has been made in the course of negotiations." (Reuters/National Post) more..

IRAQI security forces on Sunday thwarted an attack targeting a convoy for the US-led coalition against Daesh/ISIS terrorist group in southern Iraq, according to the defense ministry. (World Bulletin) more..

ISRAEL/OPT: Palestinian prisoners in Israeli detention have taken a series of actions against recent restrictions imposed on them by authorities, prisoner rights groups said, adding that Israeli measures amounted to collective punishment. (Al Jazeera) more..

Des heurts ont oppos dimanche des manifestants palestiniens la police isra lienne dans le quartier sensible de Cheikh Jarrah J rusalem-Est, apr s une visite d'un d put d'extr me droite isra lien qui a enflamm les tensions. (AFP/La Libre) plus..

Israeli forces shot dead a Palestinian during a clash in the occupied West Bank as troops prepared to demolish the home of a man accused of killing an Israeli, the Palestinian Health Ministry and witnesses said on Monday. (Reuters/Swiss Info) more..

SAUDI ARABIA-YEMEN: The Saudi-led coalition fighting Iran-backed rebels in Yemen destroyed a communications system on Monday used for drone attacks and located near the telecoms ministry in Sanaa, it said in a statement. (France24) more..

AFRICA


B NIN: Le Pr sident b ninois Patrice Talon a annonc jeudi 10 f vrier le renforcement de son plan de riposte int rieur contre les groupes arm es terroristes, mais il veut galement activer l' tat-major en vue d'une r ponse commune avec les pays voisins. (RFI) plus..

MALI: Deux soldats maliens ont t tu s t t dimanche dans le nord du Mali lors d'une attaque contre leur poste imput e des jihadistes, a annonc l'arm e sur les r seaux sociaux. (AFP/Africa Radio) more..

NIGERIA: The Police Command in Niger said its men have killed scores of terrorists in a foiled attack on Nasko in Magama Local Government Area (LGA) of the state. DSP Wasiu Abiodun, Command Public Relation Officer said a large herd of cattle was recovered and 20 abducted victims freed. (PM News Nigeria) more..

SOUDAN: Un ancien dirigeant civil du Soudan [Mohammed al-Fekki], limog lors du putsch militaire d'octobre, a t de nouveau arr t dimanche, a indiqu un cadre de son parti l'AFP, dans un pays o des dizaines de militants et d'hommes politiques prod mocratie ont t d tenus. (AFP/Africa Radio) plus..

The ZIMBABWE Teachers' Association (ZIMTA) has urged its members to return to work before the current nationwide strike degenerates into a serious conflict with the government. (VoA) more..

ASIA/PACIFIC


INDIA-PHILIPPINES: In a major boost to its defence export plans, India has signed a $375 million deal to export the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile to the Philippines. [...] This supersonic missile is an India-Russia joint venture which can be launched from submarines, ships, aircraft, or from land platforms. (Orfon Line) more..

NEPAL'S Chief Justice Is Suspended, Deepening Political Chaos. The suspension is more likely to deepen the confrontation between Nepal's governing and opposition events. (Access TV Pro) more..

AMERICAS


COLOMBIA: With a month to go before the legislative elections in Colombia take place on March 13, 163 victims of political violence have been reported, including 19 candidates and politicians who have been murdered, as reported this Sunday by the Peace and Reconciliation Foundation (Pares). (California18) more..

CUBA: Berta Soler, dirigeante du mouvement dissident cubain Damas de Blanco (les Dames en blanc), et son mari Angel Moya, ont t lib r s dimanche soir apr s avoir t arr t s plus t t dans la journ e en sortant de leur maison, galement si ge du mouvement, a-t-on appris aupr s d'une de leurs proches. (AFP/La Presse) plus..

A PERUVIAN community said on social media on Sunday that it will restart a road blockade against MMG's Las Bambas mine, even as a second community agreed to a 45-truce in its blockade. (Reuters/List123) more..

GLOBAL ISSUES


ENVIRONMENT: A zoo in southwest England is aiming to save some of the world's most endangered species from extinction by cryogenically freezing tissue and reproductive cell samples, with the aim of helping at-risk animals breed in the future. (The Independent) more..

MIGRATION: The "SOS Mediterranean" organization announced that the "Ocean Viking" ship carried out, in less than 24 hours, four relief operations in the waters of the Mediterranean, during which it rescued 228 people, including 51 minors, who were trying to reach Europe. (Libyan News Agency) more..
